units.source_text: 舞女在饭馆二楼正襟危坐，敲打着鼓。

en.t: The dancing girl sat properly upright on the second floor of the restaurant, beating the drum.

units.source_text: 我可以望见她的背影，恍如就在跟她贴邻的宴席上。

en.t: I could see her from behind, as if I were at the banquet table right beside her.

units.source_text: 鼓声牵动了我的心，舒畅极了。

en.t: The sound of the drum stirred my heart and made me feel utterly at ease.
